summary: Join our team as a Software Developer at Tesco, working on cyber software solutions and collaborating with cross-functional teams.
responsibilities: Support the design and development of cyber software solutions
Gain experience working with scalable and efficient system architectures
Write clean, maintainable code and take part in code reviews

Java, Spring Boot, and SQL for backend development
Cloud platforms like Azure or GCP
Software engineering fundamentals, version control (e.g. Git), and awareness of CI/CD concepts
benefits: 30 days of leave (18 days of Earned Leave, 12 days of Casual/Sick Leave)

Medical insurance for colleagues and their family
